purpose: Synthetic offline mapping and requirement-evaluation vectors, not live device, client-runtime or certification results.

roleProjection.assertion: Every client operation/topic atom is a consumer-manifest obligation, not a fake client affordance.

nativeContracts.assertion: Resolve every operation in the locked WSDL by namespace, portType and name. The Event service's imported Renew is not a new ONVIF-local operation.

proprietarySupport.assertion: An authentication failure must not become native or proprietary unsupported. Support facts have role and resource provenance.

timeConfiguration.reason: Selecting the manual branch does not erase the independent SetNTP-implies-GetNTP obligation.

deviceCapacities.assertion: Each capacity must be reported with provenance. At least one must be positive, not exactly one. Positive capacity is not a claim that that many resource instances are configured.

zeroCapacityInventory.assertion: Apply every case to all eight operations; capability GetServiceCapabilities is also required for both services at zero.

cases.reason: No XSD default; do not manufacture false.

subscriptions.assertion: These are arithmetic/lifecycle fixture facts only. No subscription is created on an endpoint.

eventLifecycleAsymmetry.assertion: Keep source-profile lifecycle requirements even where a later native pull workflow can keep a subscription alive without issuing Renew.

maximumUsers.assertion: This profile clause requires signaling capacity, not listing users or publishing passwords.

externalAuthorization.assertion: The client consumes a request event and sends a decision to the device. Identifier and Credential topic classes and CredentialToken are not interchangeable.

tokenReuseClasses.assertion: Canonical separation is not permission to violate native service-unique token rules. Parent-scoped identifier type names are not global credential tokens.

resourceRelationships.assertion: Keep directional AreaFrom/AreaTo and cross-service entity links; do not duplicate the shared door or mistake access-policy defaults for access-point defaults.

nativeDoorBehavior.assertion: Native state/fault semantics are separate from TD schema and are exercised only as synthetic state-machine facts here. Capability-scoped timing overrides and device-adjusted timing must not be presented as guaranteed requested timing.

processEvidence.assertion: Technical minimum and referenced policy/process obligations remain in the manifest with explicit evidence gaps; a TD cannot satisfy them.
